predecessors.name: County of Schwarzburg
predecessors.text: the Sondershausen share of the Schwarzburg lands under the Treaty of Stadtilm (21 November 1599): the Unterherrschaft round Sondershausen and the Oberherrschaft round Arnstadt

successors.name: German Empire
successors.text: the principality as a Land of the German Empire: 'It became part of the Deutsches Reich on 18 January' 1871

rulers.name: Anton Günther II (Arnstadt)
rulers.title: co-ruler of the Oberherrschaft at Arnstadt

ledger.x: 1599: the Treaty of Stadtilm divides the Schwarzburg lands; Schwarzburg-Sondershausen is born.
1871: the principality becomes a Land of the German Empire.

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: The principality 'voted against Austria's mobilization proposal' and, in 1866-1867, joined the North German Confederation; military sovereignty passed to Prussia.

certainty.note: Two detached lordships, 60 km apart; the pages name districts, not boundaries.
The lordships are named by districts (Verwaltungsbezirke of 1850); no survey line is described on the pages opened.
